description: Context The PR review daemon has a "dismissed findings" system that detects when a PR author has responded to bot review comments. On re~ reviews, these dismissed findings are passed as context so Claude doesn't re raise addressed issues. The problem: detection uses a hardcoded phrase list (DISMISSAL_ PHRASES in dismissed_ findings.py). Natural replies like "not worth doing" or "we handle this in middleware" aren't recognized — you have to say magic words like "won't fix" or "intentional"....
title: pr-review-daemon should account for comments on review comments the way a human would
